Name: Ripen
Description: Ripen (Ability 247): Consumed berries (excluding damage-reduction berries) are immediately used a second time upon consumption. Hooked on timing 0xAE (item consumption timing) as a master-table ability entry. Excludes damage-reduction berries (IDs 184-200 and 686). Includes a 4-battler re-entrancy guard table to prevent infinite consumption loops.
